name: Michael
bio: Walks, not runs. Sundays at the farmers market, not the library. Looking for someone to argue about playlists with.
whyLine: You both say sorry first. The thing to talk about early is pace—Michael wants to know where it's going.
quotes: I've got a separate playlist for late night walks.
Do you like heading out on weekends with no plan?

name: Noah
bio: Night shifts, so my weekends start on Tuesday. Big on brunch and small on plans.
whyLine: Neither of you labels things early. Noah's short, fast replies are the thing to get used to.
quotes: I'm better in person than over text, honestly.

name: Ethan
bio: I redesign menus in my head while ordering. Trail runs on Saturdays, naps on Sundays.
whyLine: Keeps it light in a disagreement, but didn't ask a follow-up when I shared something.
quotes: I need a plan, even for a lazy day.
Running is the only time my brain is quiet.

name: Paul
bio: Will defend my bagel place to the end. Early riser, late texter.
whyLine: No grudges after a disagreement. Ask about workday check-ins—Paul goes quiet.
quotes: There's exactly one good bagel place in the city and it's not yours.

name: Sam
bio: Field work most weeks, which means I own more boots than shoes. Looking for someone who likes being outside.
whyLine: Same slow-and-steady pace. Sam wants comfort in words; you show it in actions.
quotes: I'd rather be cold outside than warm on a couch.
Ask me about soil, I dare you.

name: Lucas
bio: Saturday market, Sunday reset. I keep a running list of cafés with good light.
whyLine: You both ask follow-ups. Lucas wants a reply the same night—worth saying how you do evenings.
quotes: I go to the market before it gets crowded, around eight.
A good café is about the light, not the coffee.

name: Max
bio: I fix things for fun and break them for science. Weekends are for the garage and the ocean.
whyLine: Says sorry without being asked. Different lines on what's fair to ask about early.
quotes: I don't really do small talk, sorry.
If it has an engine, I've probably taken it apart.

name: Aiden
bio: I draw buildings for a living and walk past the good ones on purpose. Weekend gallery person.
whyLine: Slow, short replies, and you'd read that as disinterest. The pace otherwise fits.
quotes: I'll take a long walk over almost anything.
Galleries are better when they're empty.
